sentence: This project builds a platform that separates molecules in the gas phase based on differences in shape, charge, and chemical reactivity.
This project plans how a university can build up its computing support for research in fields such as genomics and chemistry.
This project builds a platform that uses artificial intelligence to speed up prior authorization for cancer treatment in oncology clinics.
This project builds a framework for designing how hydrogels are made and printed together to reach the desired product performance.
This project teaches the basics of quantum computing through hands-on activities with polarizing filters and a computer program.
This project builds an interactive web-based platform that shows how attacks and defenses affect multimodal artificial intelligence systems.
This project studies how sleep in the honeybee brain supports memory and uses what it finds to help artificial intelligence keep learning.
This project builds the physics of touch into the models that generate robot motions, so robots need less data and act more reliably.
This project designs artificial materials that bend light much more than natural substances, using nanocrystals and computer modeling.
This project studies how objects look different in different countries and how language can help computers find them in images.
This project studies tensor categories, which grow out of how symmetries are represented by matrices, and the connections between them.
This project sets up a computing cluster that runs machine learning, whole-genome sequencing, and simulations across many science fields.
This project studies how and why cracks form where different metals meet during additive manufacturing, and how to avoid them.
This project assesses a computing hardware design that holds its programmed states without continuous power, using magneto-optical phase elements.
This project designs a curriculum that shows how to build, test, and secure systems that use artificial intelligence.
This project tries to find out how movement, community travel, and social participation fit together to describe mobility in natural environments.
